channel.title: Meridian incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Meridian's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Data Processing Delays - Reporting Tools Affected [resolved]
item.description: Between 2:11 PM and 2:23 PM Eastern, some customers accessing view.meridiankiosks.com experienced service unavailability. Monitoring alerts triggered an investigation that quickly isolated the issue to an application-level fault affecting request handling for a subset of sessions. Engineering implemented a targeted patch to remediate the fault and restore normal service.

item.title: Chase Payment Processing incident (Resolved) [resolved]
item.description: MzeroPay customers using Chase may have experienced an interruption in payment processing services due to an outage at Chase. The issue was with the 3rd party Chase platform from around 4:45 AM EST on 09/08/2025. The incident has been resolved, and regular transaction traffic has returned.
